summary: Image build: pick a bootc base (Fedora, CentOS, RHEL), layer the Edge Manager agent, config and optional drivers, host config and apps in a Containerfile, build, sign and publish with podman and skopeo, then create a disk image with bootc-image-builder (needed once for provisioning; updates use only the bootc image).
questions: How do I build an OS image for Red Hat Edge Manager?
Do I need a new disk image for every device update?
What goes into an Edge Manager bootc image?
